test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A trader claims to sell pulses at a profit of 48%, but also dishonestly uses a weight which is 12% less than what is mentioned on it. Find the total percentage of profit earned by the trader. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive percentage method: **Profit%** = 48% and **Weight Error** = 12% less.

Effective Profit Multiplier = (100 + 48) ÷ (100 − 12) = 148 ÷ 88.

Total Profit% = [(148 − 88) ÷ 88] × 100 = (60 ÷ 88) × 100.

Total Profit% = (15 ÷ 22) × 100 = 68.18% ≈ 68%.

**∴ The correct answer is 68%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Profit claimed** = 48%, **Weight reduction** = 12%.
Formulas: Profit% = (Total Gain ÷ Actual Weight) × 100 | Dishonest gain% = [Error + Profit%] ÷ [True Value − Error] × 100.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91d54c04f9144278f9fb2df446eb0eb005185f4876e40def900970f27db3a946.png] 
⇒ Let the **cost price** of 1000g be 1000 units.
⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 1000 + 48% of 1000 = 1480 units.
⇒ Actual weight used = 1000 − 12% of 1000 = 880g.
⇒ The **effective cost price** for the trader = 880 units.
⇒ Total Profit = 1480 − 880 = 600 units.
⇒ Profit% = (600 ÷ 880) × 100 = 68.18%.
⇒ Rounding off to the nearest whole number gives 68%.
**∴ The correct answer is 68%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

A dealer can earn profit by two ways: increasing the **Selling Price** and using **False Weights**. Total Gain% = [(True Weight − False Weight) + Profit% on True Weight] ÷ [False Weight] × 100.

Rounding Off Rules

If the decimal part is **0.5 or more**, round up; if it is **less than 0.5**, round down. Here 68.18% rounds to 68%.</p
